UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Public player profile without PII, tracking career crossword statistics and display handle.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player

displayName.description: Player chosen display handle on leaderboards

puzzlesSolved.description: Total count of unique crosswords solved by the player

totalScore.description: Cumulative fixed score earned across solved puzzles

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated

LeaderboardScore.title: LeaderboardScore
LeaderboardScore.description: Permanent leaderboard score record for a completed 20x20 or 8x8 crossword puzzle.

scoreId.description: Deterministic or unique score document ID

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player who achieved the score

puzzleId.description: ID of the completed crossword puzzle

puzzleTitle.description: Title of the completed crossword puzzle

gridSize.description: Grid dimension (8 for Quick 8x8, 20 for Standard 20x20)

score.description: Final score based on the easiest clue base chosen that day (1000, 2000, or 3000) minus 25 points for every 60 seconds taken (minimum 0)

hintsUsed.description: Number of hints used during the solve

easiestDifficultyUsed.description: Easiest clue difficulty base chosen for this puzzle

clueDifficulty.description: Final active clue difficulty when completed

completedAt.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD in Europe/London when completed

isPublic.description: Whether the score entry is visible on the global leaderboard

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial score submission

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest score update

PlayerPuzzleProgress.title: PlayerPuzzleProgress
PlayerPuzzleProgress.description: Per-user per-puzzle permanent tracking of easiest clue difficulty base chosen and completion status.

easiestDifficultyUsed.description: Easiest clue difficulty selected by the player for this puzzle

completed.description: Whether the player has completed this puzzle

/users/{userId}.description: Public player profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/puzzle_progress/{puzzleI.description: Subcollection storing a player's locked easiest clue difficulty base and completion state per puzzle.

/leaderboard_scores/{scoreId}.description: Global permanent leaderboard entries across 20x20 Standard and 8x8 Quick crosswords.
